reviews.title: Needs Improvement
reviews.text:
I used to enjoy using Stridekick. First started using it as an alternative to the FitBit app. As others have said, they have changed the app a lot and seem to be trying to force users into a monthly plan. The monthly plan is priced too high and I pay a monthly FitBit fee just to compete in Bingo challenges.
With Stridekick,  the current free tier does not give me confidence that the “Pro” tier would be money well spent. Yes, spam users and cheaters are a big problem! The free challenges that they offer continue to decline. One of their recent New Years challenges had the year 2022 in the image! I am starting to look for a new app. 
Stridekick had a lot of potential, but I think they let a huge opportunity slip through their hands. Most of my old Fitbit friends are no longer using this app.
